`Output #0, mp3, to '/Users/younes/Desktop/Wolffish Cinematic Reveal Segments/Segment 1.mp3':`

So it wrote to the right place. The `[wolffish-output: ...]` line at the bottom might just be a system-level note about where workspace-relative files go, but the actual output went to the path I specified.
